facts.business: VL E-Governance & IT Solutions Limited is an e-governance and IT/ITES company with experience in systems integration, data digitisation, and large-scale government programmes under India's National e-Governance Plan, including international projects like the Philippines Land Titling Computerization Project.

guidance_or_targets.statement: The company plans to bid for new upcoming large scale Government projects including ULPIN, Aadhaar Integration with Land Records, NAKSHA under DILRMP, PM e-Drive EV Charging Station Operator (CPO), and Solar Power Project.

auditor.name: M/s B K G & Associates, Chartered Accountants, Mumbai
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key audit matters: Expected Credit Loss assessment and Litigation matters. Opinion not modified in respect of these matters.

key_risks: Limited operating activity in FY2026 with revenue decline from Rs 3,068.86 lakhs to Rs 1,715.43 lakhs
Loss before interest, depreciation, taxation, exceptional item and amortization of Rs 96.67 lakhs
Significant judgment in calculating expected credit losses
Litigation matters requiring evaluation of provisions and disclosures
Transition phase after demerger from Vakrangee Limited with new leadership and strategy
facts.related_party_note: The company was originally incorporated as a wholly owned subsidiary of Vakrangee Limited. The E-Governance & IT/ITES business of Vakrangee Limited was transferred to VL E-Governance & IT Solutions Limited under a Scheme of Arrangement sanctioned by NCLT.
